hero.lede: MusiqualiT creates intimate, carefully produced music experiences that put Montréal's Black and racialized artists in the spotlight.

why.body: Montréal, Quebec and Canada are full of talented Black and racialized artists. What's missing is the infrastructure to help them grow, professionalize and deliver ever stronger musical experiences. MusiqualiT was founded to fill part of that gap, alongside other organizations: the work needed is bigger than any one group.

meeting.title: The first meeting

arrangement.title: The arrangement

rehearsals.title: Rehearsals

show.title: The show

about.intro: Building the industry we never saw.

story.body1: In 2017, Imani Joseph left a comfortable major-label job. She opened a small studio in the Mile-End with a fixed idea: give artists of colour what she'd never received — the time, the listening, the respect, and a plan.
story.body2: Eight years later, MusiqualiT is an ecosystem: studio, mentorship, development programs, community nights. More than 120 artists have come through our doors.
